augments.description: Your Shop is disabled temporarily; afterward, you gain XP.

augments.name: Tons of Stats!
augments.description: Your team gains Health, Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Mana.

augments.name: Trade Sector
augments.description: Gain a Shop reroll every round and gain gold.

augments.name: Trade Sector+
augments.description: Gain a Shop reroll every round and gain gold.

augments.name: U.R.F
augments.description: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain Attack Speed and Mana Regen.

augments.name: Verticality II
augments.description: Champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

augments.name: Warpath
augments.description: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing player damage, gain a chest of high-cost champions and items.

augments.name: Weight The Worth
augments.description: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

augments.name: Worth the Wait
augments.description: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Woven Magic
augments.description: Gain a random item component. As your champions spend Mana, gain additional components at recurring Mana-spent intervals, up to a maximum.

augments.name: Zeke's Herald
augments.description: Gain a Zeke's Herald, which grants Attack Speed to the holder and allies in the same row within its range.

augments.name: Zz'Rot Portal
augments.description: Gain a Zz'Rot Portal, an item which summons a large Voidspawn.

augments.name: Arcanist Circlet
augments.description: Gain an Arcanist Emblem, a Tear of the Goddess, and an Ahri.

augments.name: Arcanist Crown
augments.description: Gain an Arcanist Emblem, a Jeweled Gauntlet, and a Swain.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II
augments.description: Gain Thief's Gloves, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II+
augments.description: Gain Thief's Gloves, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II++
augments.description: Gain Thief's Gloves, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Baron's Lair
augments.description: Gain a random Tank item. After a delay in combat, your team gains bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

augments.name: Beach Pop Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Beach Pop Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and a Graves.

augments.name: Beach Pop Crown
augments.description: Gain a Beach Pop Emblem, a Blue Buff, and a Syndra.

augments.name: Belt Overflow
augments.description: Gain Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant bonus Health.

augments.name: Birthday Present
augments.description: Gain a 2-star champion and gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is below your level and capped at a maximum.

augments.name: Booster Box
augments.description: Gain a pack of champions now and at the start of upcoming stages. At least one holographic is guaranteed!

augments.name: Build A Bud
augments.description: Gain a random champion and gold.

augments.name: Buried Treasures III
augments.description: Gain a random item component now and at the start of the next several rounds.

augments.name: Call To Chaos
augments.description: Gain a powerful and random reward.

augments.name: Celestial Blessing III
augments.description: Your team gains Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted into a shield, up to a maximum shield size.

augments.name: Cheat Code III
augments.description: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.

augments.name: Choreographer Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Choreographer Emblem, a Giant's Belt, and a Garen.

augments.name: Choreographer Crown
augments.description: Gain a Choreographer Emblem, an Adaptive Helm, and a Syndra.

augments.name: Classical Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Classical Emblem, a B.F. Sword, and a Jhin.

augments.name: Classical Crown
augments.description: Gain a Classical Emblem, a Spirit Visage, and a Nasus.

augments.name: Cloning
augments.description: After each player combat, gain a copy of a random champion on your board. If your board has few unique champions, you may instead gain gold.

augments.name: Comeback Story
augments.description: Your team gains Health and Attack Speed for each point of player Health you’re missing.

augments.name: Commerce Core
augments.description: Gain free Shop rerolls immediately and each round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Component Quest
augments.description: Gain a random component and gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain gold.

augments.name: Cursed Crown
augments.description: Increase your maximum team size, but take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

augments.name: Deadlier Blades
augments.description: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain Attack Damage each time their holders score a takedown.

augments.name: Deadlier Caps
augments.description: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant Mana Regen and permanently gain Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

augments.name: Duplicator Deal
augments.description: Gain Champion Duplicators. You can no longer 3-star champions.

augments.name: Expected Unexpectedness
augments.description: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.

augments.name: Flexible
augments.description: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains Health for each Emblem they are holding.

augments.name: Forged In Strength
augments.description: Gain a random Artifact. When you drop below a Health threshold, gain more random Artifacts, a random completed item, and random components.

augments.name: Giant and Mighty
augments.description: Your team becomes large, gaining Health and maximum Health.

augments.name: Golden Gamble
augments.description: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Golden Gamble+
augments.description: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Golden Gamble++
augments.description: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Hard Commit
augments.description: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

augments.name: Heartsteel Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Heartsteel Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and a Yone.

augments.name: Heartsteel Crown
augments.description: Gain a Heartsteel Emblem, a Steadfast Heart, and a K'Sante.

augments.name: Hedge Fund
augments.description: Gain gold. Your maximum interest is increased to 10.

augments.name: Hitmaker Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, a B.F. Sword, and a Xayah.

augments.name: Hitmaker Crown
augments.description: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

augments.name: Hold the Line
augments.description: Allies in your back 2 rows gain Ability Power and Attack Damage for each ally that starts combat in your front row.

augments.name: Illbeats Circlet
augments.description: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Tear Of The Goddess, and a Draven.

augments.name: Illbeats Crown
augments.description: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Gargoyle Stoneplate, and a Braum.

augments.name: Invested+
augments.description: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

augments.name: Invested++
augments.description: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

augments.name: Investment Strategy II
augments.description: Your champions gain permanent max health per interest you earn. Your maximum interest increases, and you gain gold now.

augments.name: Ionic Spark Circlet
augments.description: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and an Aurora.

augments.name: Ionic Spark Crown
augments.description: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, an Ionic Spark, and an Annie.

augments.name: Jazz Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Jazz Emblem, a Recurve Bow, and a Bard.

augments.name: Jazz Crown
augments.description: Gain a Jazz Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and a Lucian.

augments.name: K/DA Circlet
augments.description: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Leona.

augments.name: K/DA Crown
augments.description: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Guinsoo's Rageblade, and a Kai'Sa.

augments.name: Level Up!
augments.description: Whenever you buy XP, gain additional XP, and gain XP immediately.

augments.name: Living Forge
augments.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil now, then again at recurring player-combat intervals.

augments.name: Lucky Gloves
augments.description: Thief's Gloves always give your champions ideal items. Gain Sparring Gloves and gold.

augments.name: Lucky Gloves+
augments.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain Sparring Gloves now, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Luxury Subscription
augments.description: Gain a package containing a champion and a 2-star champion, plus gold. At the start of each of the following stages, gain the package again.

augments.name: Mad Science
augments.description: Each ally randomly becomes either huge or tiny. Huge units gain max Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power; tiny units gain Durability and Attack Speed.

augments.name: Management Track
augments.description: Gain a Manager Emblem. When champions gain bonuses from Manager, you have a chance to gain gold. After collecting gold from the Manager trait, gain a 2-star Dr. Mundo and Warmog's Armor.

augments.name: Manager Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Manager Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Leona.

augments.name: Min-Max
augments.description: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and gold.

augments.name: Money Monsoon
augments.description: Gain gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Nesting Anvils
augments.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. Open it to gain a Component Anvil, then open that to gain gold.

augments.name: Nesting Anvils+
augments.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After opening it, gain a Component Anvil. After opening that, gain gold.

augments.name: One Buff Two Buff
augments.description: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

augments.name: Pain into Passion
augments.description: On the A-Side, True Damage champions gain Attack Speed and Health for each Bling collected. On the B-Side, gain Gold after losing combat. Gain 3 True Damage champions.

augments.name: Pandora's Box
augments.description: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Then reforge all of your items, gain a random gold augment, and gain a random completed item.

augments.name: Pandora's Items III
augments.description: At the start of each round, items on your bench are randomized. Gain Radiant items.

augments.name: Pentakill Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Negatron Cloak, and a Yorick.

augments.name: Pentakill Crown
augments.description: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Giant Slayer, and a Viego.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny
augments.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and gold.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny+
augments.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and gold.

augments.name: Prismatic Ticket
augments.description: Each time your shop is rerolled, you may gain a free reroll.

augments.name: Radiant Rascal
augments.description: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

augments.name: Radiant Relics
augments.description: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

augments.name: Renegade Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and an Aurora.

augments.name: Renegade Crown
augments.description: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Hand of Justice, and a Qiyana.

augments.name: Rock Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Locke.

augments.name: Rock Crown
augments.description: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Hand Of Justice, and a Camille.

augments.name: Royalties
augments.description: Gain a Tactician’s Crown. Gain gold every round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Shimmerscale Essence
augments.description: Gain a Gambler's Blade, then gain a Mogul's Mail after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Shopping Spree
augments.description: When you level up, gain Shop refreshes based on your level. Gain gold.

augments.name: Slayer Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Slayer Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Yone.

augments.name: Slayer Crown
augments.description: Gain a Slayer Emblem, a Titan's Resolve, and a Briar.

augments.name: Soul Awakening
augments.description: At combat start, your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power each second. At max stacks, it deals bonus true damage.

augments.name: Star of the Show
augments.description: Gain a non-Tank champion and an Emblem for one of their traits. At a later stage, gain more copies of that champion.

augments.name: Strange Duet III
augments.description: Allies that start combat isolated in pairs gain Durability and Damage Amp.

augments.name: Sweet Treats
augments.description: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains Health for each item equipped to a champion.

augments.name: Swiftstriker Circlet
augments.description: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Recurve Bow, and a Bard.

augments.name: Swiftstriker Crown
augments.description: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Hextech Gunblade, and a Bard.

augments.name: Sword Overflow
augments.description: Gain BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant Attack Speed.

augments.name: Tactician's Kitchen
augments.description: Gain a random Emblem. After a round-based delay, gain a Tactician's Cape.

augments.name: The Golden Egg
augments.description: Gain a golden egg that eventually hatches and grants a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat advances its hatch timer by one turn.

augments.name: The Immortal Journey
augments.description: Gain a Xayah, a Spear of Shojin, and gold.

augments.name: The Trait Tree
augments.description: Gain random Emblems and gold.

augments.name: The Trait Tree+
augments.description: Gain random Emblems, a Reforger, and gold.

augments.name: Three Steps Ahead
augments.description: For each of your next player-combat losses, gain a 5-cost champion and components.

augments.name: TONS of Stats!
augments.description: Your team gains Health, Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Mana.

augments.name: Trait Ladder
augments.description: Gain a random emblem. In a player combat, field non-unique traits to earn a reward; the trait requirement and reward size then increase.

augments.name: True Damage Circlet
augments.description: Gain a True Damage Emblem, a Giant's Belt, and an Ekko.

augments.name: True Damage Crown
augments.description: Gain a True Damage Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

augments.name: Unearthed Treasure
augments.description: After player combat, each unique Beach Pop champion empowered by a Beach Pop instrument has a chance to uncover some loot! Gain a Taric, a Zoe, and a Renekton.

augments.name: Upward Mobility
augments.description: Buying XP costs less. Gain Health and Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

augments.name: Urf's Grab Bag
augments.description: Gain Spatula, random components, and gold.

augments.name: Verticality III
augments.description: Champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

augments.name: Wand Overflow
augments.description: Gain Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant Attack Speed.

augments.name: We Stick Together
augments.description: Gain an Emblem for a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain Attack Speed.

augments.name: Worth the Wait II
augments.description: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.
